description: This PHP class, KpiMenuConfigurator, is part of the OrangeHRM application and implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to KPI in the Performance module. It overrides the current screen to 'searchKpi'.

classes.name: KpiMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures KPI menu settings by overriding the current screen to 'searchKpi' within the Performance module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'searchKpi' and returns null.
